note: Human-curated normalization decisions for build_kb.py. This is the INTERPRETATION layer: everything here is DERIVED from source text, never invented. Each entry records what was interpreted, why, and which source supports it. Raw files are never edited.

project_cost_min.interpretation: Raw float '140000.01' in field 'project_cost_min_inclusive' is an encoding hack for a strict/exclusive lower bound: project cost must EXCEED Rs 1,40,000.

branches.note: Scheme notes: '12-month moratorium for plantation and construction activities.' Corroborated by Excel Current Scheme Snapshot (TL row).
Default per current scheme page (S001) and Excel Snapshot.

moratorium_months_conditional.note: Normalized from moratorium_months=6 plus free-text notes.

beneficiary_rate.note: Normalized from string '13 (Co-op Banks/Societies); 15 (SFBs)'. Value 13; 'Co-op Banks/Societies' is treated as a channel-group alias.

repayment.note: Normalized from string '12 if repayment has not started; 10 if repayment has started'. Excel Snapshot corroborates 'Up to 10-12 years depending on status'.

branches.note: Course period is course-specific and NOT in the KB; requires user input or course-family assumption (M0 B7).
'up to 6 months if repayment has started'

moratorium.note: Normalized from string 'Course period + 1 year if repayment has not started; up to 6 months if repayment has started'.

loan_cap_formula.source_note: Scheme notes: 'Maximum is Rs 40 lakh or 90% of course fee, whichever is less.'

rule_scope.notes: Maps the source string scope column to machine scope objects. scope_derived=true anywhere the mapping is an interpretation.

E001.notes: Source scope: 'All NSFDC credit/loan schemes'. Interpreted as all 5 core schemes in this KB.

E002.notes: Source scope: 'All NSFDC credit/loan schemes'. Effective date 2026-01-07 extracted from explanation text.

E005.notes: Source scope: 'Income-generating activities'. Partnership: ALL members SC; each member family income <= 5L.

E006.notes: Source scope: 'Income-generating activities'. Society: ALL members SC; each member family income <= 5L.

E007.notes: Source scope: 'Skill Development Training' — a DOMAIN OUTSIDE the 5 core schemes (DQ-007). Do NOT auto-apply to loan eligibility; no income criterion stated. Retained in KB for context/FAQ matching.

data_quality_issues.description: Term Loan lower bound encoded as float 140000.01 in 'project_cost_min_inclusive' — an encoding hack for a strict/exclusive boundary (> Rs 1,40,000). Value carries paise precision not present in the real scheme.
data_quality_issues.recommended_resolution: M0 B2: model as explicit exclusive flag (cost_min_inclusive=false, value=140000). Official boundary semantics still to be verified from scheme document.

data_quality_issues.description: UNY beneficiary_interest_rate is a channel-dependent string ('13 (Co-op Banks/Societies); 15 (SFBs)') instead of a scalar. Modeled as conditional on channel_type; applicability rules must be verified.
data_quality_issues.recommended_resolution: Keep conditional model; verify channel-to-rate mapping from UNY policy document.

data_quality_issues.description: ELS repayment_years is a state-dependent string ('12 if repayment has not started; 10 if repayment has started'). Modeled as conditional on repayment_has_started.
data_quality_issues.recommended_resolution: Verify from ELS borrow/repayment terms (S019 ELS policy).

data_quality_issues.description: ELS moratorium_months is a state-dependent string ('Course period + 1 year ... ; up to 6 months ...'). Moratorium depends on course duration which is NOT in the KB (user input or course-family assumption needed, M0 B7).
data_quality_issues.recommended_resolution: Keep string form for the course-period branch; surface as a clarifier.

data_quality_issues.description: ELS max_loan_amount (4,000,000) equals project_cost_max (4,000,000), while financing_percent=90 and the cap rule is 'lesser of Rs 40L or 90% of course fee'. A pure 90% model would cap the loan at 90% of project cost. The stated equality implies the Rs 40L cap dominates; mathematics needs official verification (course fee never in KB).
data_quality_issues.recommended_resolution: M0 B7: engine should compute cap as min(40L, 90% x course_fee) using user-supplied course fee; keep project_cost_max as ELS admission ceiling.

data_quality_issues.description: E002 income-ceiling effective date '2026-01-07' is embedded in rule explanation free-text. No publish/effective metadata exists on the source pages.
data_quality_issues.recommended_resolution: Promote to effective_from=2026-01-07 (done in normalized rule). Verify whether this denotes a revised income ceiling.

data_quality_issues.description: E007 is scoped to 'Skill Development Training' — a program domain OUTSIDE the 5 core credit/loan schemes in this KB. It must not be interpreted as a loan eligibility rule. Retained for context/FAQ use only.
data_quality_issues.recommended_resolution: Keep scope EXTERNAL_DOMAIN; exclude from loan evaluator unless the product defines a Skills domain (post-M1).

data_quality_issues.description: NSFDC Compendium of Schemes (S009): raw JSON marks it 'Secondary/historical'; Excel Source Register (01_Core) marks Authority 'Primary'. Both representations preserved; NOT auto-resolved.
data_quality_issues.recommended_resolution: M0 B1 (recommendation: treat S009 as Secondary/historical; rely on current pages for live parameters).

data_quality_issues.description: KB/Master DB.txt is empty (0 bytes). Source register + scheme master JSON are the operative raw inputs. Empty file preserved unmodified.
data_quality_issues.recommended_resolution: Resolved by design: JSON + Excel are the authoritative raw set; Master DB.txt kept as-is (M0 B4).

data_quality_issues.description: Partner master data (names, states, districts, addresses, coordinates, phone, eligibility conditions, utilisation figures) is NOT ingested. Only partner PDF URLs are registered. Never fabricate partner facts.
data_quality_issues.recommended_resolution: M1.9: define partner schema + documented ingestion gap; partner ingestion recommended in the follow-on milestone (needs official PDF download; team decision required).

data_quality_issues.description: Exact per-scheme document checklists are not present in the corpus. Only the caste certificate requirement is rule-verified (E003). Application/limitation: P1 checklist output must clearly mark documents as indicative.
data_quality_issues.recommended_resolution: Confirm final document list from application forms (S006) during M2 verification.

data_quality_issues.description: The corpus does not state per-activity or per-scheme eligibility. Activity-to-scheme mappings in this KB are UNVERIFIED (sector-level inheritance). Tailoring etc. must NOT be treated as verified eligible without individual confirmation (M2/Gemini).
data_quality_issues.recommended_resolution: M1.6 marks all activity mappings UNVERIFIED; per-activity verification is a follow-on task.

data_quality_issues.description: Two exact-duplicate activity names appear in two sectors each: 'Bicycle Repairing Shops' (Small Industries + Service & Transport) and 'Saw Mills' (Small Industries + Service & Transport). Merged into single activity records carrying both sector_ids; both raw entries preserved in raw JSON.
data_quality_issues.recommended_resolution: Resolved in M1.6: single activity id with multi-sector membership. Also note near-duplicates (see M1_1 audit section 10) left untouched by design.
